editorial:
Imagine landing in a city where you cannot trust anyone and danger is around every corner. You follow an American man who heads back to Shanghai right before the big attack on Pearl Harbor. He is looking for answers about a friend who was killed, but he quickly finds himself caught in a web of lies. The vibe is dark and moody, making you feel the tension of a city occupied by the Japanese military. Along the way, he falls for a local woman, and together they realize that the people supposed to be the good guys are actually hiding some pretty scary secrets.

The acting is solid and the mystery keeps you guessing until the end. While some parts of the story move a bit slow, the twists and the period costumes make up for it. If you enjoy spy stories with a bit of romance, you will really like this one. To get the most out of the gritty visuals, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video or renting it on Apple TV. If you are a fan of physical media, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your collection is a great way to keep this hidden gem forever.
endingExplained: You find out that the American government was actually working with the Japanese to protect their own business interests. The main character discovers that his friend was killed because he knew too much about this dirty deal. In the end, he manages to expose the truth and escape the city just as the war breaks out. He chooses love and honor over the lies of his own country, leaving the corruption behind as the world changes forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves old-school spy thrillers and historical mysteries.
